# Fieldcraft

> Fieldcraft (https://fieldcraft.co.in) is an Indian resume writing, CV writing, LinkedIn profile and portfolio website service, run from Pune. It rebuilds the resume or notes a person already has into the format hiring managers in their own profession expect — ATS-friendly, as a PDF and an editable Word file within 24 hours — and builds one-page portfolio websites that go live in 3–5 days. Prices start at ₹99.

Fieldcraft is a writing service, not a do-it-yourself resume builder: customers send their current resume, notes or work, and receive finished documents or a finished website. It serves students and freshers through to senior leaders in 13 professions, and customers anywhere in India (and Indians applying abroad).

## Prices (launch pricing, Indian rupees)

- Resume health check (ATS parse test and written notes): ₹49
- Resume, one page, ATS-friendly: ₹99
- CV (curriculum vitae), long-form: ₹199
- LinkedIn profile rewrite: ₹149
- Portfolio website, one page, 10 themes, hosted free in the customer's name: ₹699 (own domain connected: +₹349)
- Bundles: Job Ready (resume + LinkedIn) ₹199; Full Record (resume + CV) ₹249; Complete (resume, CV, LinkedIn and portfolio) ₹999
- Every order includes one revision round. Nothing is charged until the customer agrees the price by email.
